correctness.rationale: The stationary size-biased interval representation is standard and was independently checked against the primary full text. The covariance/variance decompositions are exact. Two-point size-biased laws prove sharpness and interval filling.

value.rationale: The unequal-power problem is the natural asymmetric extension of a sharp renewal-dependence invariant. It has exact distribution-free endpoints, complete extremizer classification, and full attainability by two-point renewals. The mechanism cleanly separates negative within-interval competition from positive common-length heterogeneity.
